_about: Cases for the recruiter review (Stage 1). Real bullets from the owner's resumes, in both their polished and vague forms. None of these appear in the reviewer prompt's examples, so the eval stays an independent check. `expect` lists the acceptable decisions; where two are listed the case is genuinely open and only a bad third option fails it. No database: the reviewer is a pure function plus one model call.

backend.title: Backend Software Engineer
backend.summary: Builds and operates the services behind the ordering platform: APIs, data storage, background jobs.

cases.text: Built an LLM-powered job analysis and resume tailoring platform with server-enforced grounding: proposed edits are rejected unless their cited evidence belongs to the user and was retrieved during the same agent run.

cases.text: Implemented reserve-before-spend idempotency for job-draft creation so duplicate requests cannot trigger duplicate LLM calls, with stored-response replay after completion.
